jobs.description:
For a company based in Veurne, specialised in metalworking, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in various shift systems.

You will be working in an ultra-modern production environment that meets the highest standards in terms of quality, productivity and innovation. A very interesting opportunity for you!

Your responsibilities:

• As a Maintenance Technician, you will support customers with their maintenance activities.
• You will mainly be responsible for preventive and corrective maintenance, repairs and the replacement of spare parts on industrial installations.
• You are able to work independently and are skilled in assembling and dismantling mechanical components.
• You will mainly work as part of the customer's technical maintenance team, always respecting the safety regulations applicable on site.
• You are responsible for accurately completing work orders and providing daily reports to the internal department.
• You work autonomously and maintain good communication with the customer.
• You have strong analytical skills to identify and troubleshoot technical faults and defects.
For this challenging position, you naturally need to have the right skills and experience.

• You have a strong ELECTRICAL & MECHANICAL BACKGROUND, with at least 5 years of experience as an industrial electrician.
• You are flexible regarding work locations, as you will work at different sites on a project basis.
• You are open to working in shifts (2-shift system, day shifts or night shifts – NEGOTIABLE).
• You are independent, eager to learn and not afraid of getting your hands dirty.
• You hold a valid category B driving licence and speak fluent DUTCH OR ENGLISH.

Lead Growth. Win Business. Shape the Future.
 

Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is a market-leading upscale business hotel at the heart of Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport. Home to 315 guestrooms, 18 newly refreshed meeting rooms and one of Belgium's premier conference venues, the hotel welcomes a diverse international mix of corporate, 
airline and MICE guests. 
Are you a commercial hunter with a passion for hospitality? Do you thrive on winning new business, building strategic partnerships and leading high-performing sales teams? We're looking for an ambitious Director of Sales to lead the commercial strategy of our international hotel. This isn't an account management role— 
it's a leadership position for someone who loves prospecting, negotiating and closing deals while leveraging the power of a global hotel network.
 

What you'll doYou'll drive business growth across Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments by: 
• Leading and inspiring a team of business developers with a strong hunting mindset. 
• Prospecting, negotiating and securing new local and international accounts. 
• Managing the full RFP process and maximizing opportunities from IHG's global sales network. 
• Growing our Meetings & Events business by increasing conversion and developing long-term client relationships. 
• Using CRM and performance data to build a strong commercial pipeline and deliver measurable results. 
• With the help of a marketing officer and/or an agency, leverage digital marketing, content and social media to fuel lead generation, reinforce brand identity and support commercial growth. 
• Working closely with the General Manager and operational teams to ensure every client experience matches our commercial promise

Who you are• A proven hunter with a strong track record of winning new business. 
• At least 4 years' experience in hotel or hospitality sales, including team leadership. 
• Experience with Corporate, MICE and RFP management within an international environment is a strong advantage. 
• Commercially driven, analytical and results oriented. 
• Comfortable using CRM tools and managing a structured sales pipeline. 
• Fluent in French and Dutch. English is a big asset.

jobs.description:
Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is one of Belgium's leading upscale business hotels, ideally located in 
Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport and NATO headquarters. With 315 stylish guestrooms, 
18 state-of-the-art meeting spaces, newly refreshed extensive meeting- and event facilities and a strong 
international corporate clientele, the hotel is recognized as a premier destination for meetings, conferences 
and business travel. Join a dynamic commercial team where innovation, relationship-building and driving 
results are at the heart of everything we do.
 

Ready to hunt, win and grow?
 

We're looking for a driven Sales Manager who loves opening new doors, building strong client relationships 
and closing deals. This is a true business development role. Your mission is simple: generate new business 
across our Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments and help position Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport 
as the preferred hotel in the market.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Hunt for new business opportunities and build your own client portfolio. 

• Negotiate and close commercial agreements. 

• Develop and manage a strong sales pipeline using our CRM. 

• Identify market trends and new business opportunities. 

• Work closely with our commercial and operational teams to deliver outstanding guest 

Who you are• A natural hunter with a passion for sales.
• A bachelor’s degree
 or equivalent in Hotel Management/Business Administration, 
or equivalent experience.
• Experienced in business development: hospitality experience is a strong advantage.
• Confident negotiator with a results-driven mindset.
• Comfortable working with a CRM and sales targets.
• Fluent in English and either French 
or Dutch.
• Flexible to meet clients and attend events outside standard office hours when required.

Objectives 

• Participate in on-site technical surveys to define installation principles and document the selected solutions.
• Translate electrical schematics into practical onboard installation solutions.
• Prepare the Bill of Materials (BOM) in compliance with technical constraints and applicable standards.
• Produce final electrical schematics and associated wiring lists.
• Design wiring harnesses in accordance with railway standards and prepare manufacturing specifications.
• Collaborate with mechanical engineering teams to define the final installation solution and parts breakdown.
• Prepare installation procedures describing the activities to be performed. 
Educational Requirements

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field.
• Previous experience in electrical design within an engineering environment is preferred.
Desired Knowledge / Experience

• Experience with electrical design software such as E3S, EPLAN, or similar tools.
• Experience in the railway or transportation industry is considered an advantage.
• Understanding of the V-cycle development methodology is a plus.
• Familiarity with PLM tools such as ENOVIA is an advantage.
• Strong technical writing skills, with a focus on clarity and accuracy.
• Professional proficiency in English.
• Knowledge of French is a plus.
Behavioural Skills / Competencies

• Strong team spirit and ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment.
• Rigorous, curious, and open-minded approach.
• Autonomous, proactive, and solution-oriented.
• Good verbal and written communication skills.
• Perseverance and ability to take ownership of assigned activities. 
Working Conditions

• Company car with fuel card
• Representation fees
• Meal vouchers
• Mobile phone subscription

What we offer

System Designer - English required - ALTEN Belgium

The Position

As part of our ongoing growth, we are looking for a System Designer to join our teams and work on client projects located in Charleroi.

As a System Designer, your main responsibilities will include:

• Define and allocate requirements to subsystems in collaboration with system, architecture, and software teams to ensure safe and efficient solutions.
• Analyze the impact of changes on existing systems and propose optimized solutions.
• Contribute to pre-integration strategies and ensure compatibility of elements and interfaces across all subsystems.
• Support project disciplines (software engineering, verification & validation, safety, certification) and assist in resolving technical issues.

The role
We are looking for a hands-on Studio Manager to take responsibility for the day-to-day operation of ANKHA House. You will lead the member experience, coordinate the team, maintain the studio's standards, and keep operations running smoothly.

This is a management role, not a teaching role. You will work closely with the founder, who sets the overall direction and approves major business decisions. The Studio Manager is responsible for carrying that direction into the daily running of the club.
Key responsibilitiesRun daily studio operations
• Take ownership of opening and closing procedures, reception coverage, bookings, payments, and daily studio readiness.
• Make sure movement rooms, changing rooms, reception, and wellness areas are clean, stocked, organized, and ready for members.
• Manage the booking system and resolve routine booking or payment issues.
• Track equipment, supplies, and maintenance needs; arrange routine servicing and follow up with suppliers.
• Keep operating procedures up to date and make sure the team follows them.
• Identify operational problems early and resolve them where possible.Lead the member experience
• Ensure every member and guest receives a warm, attentive, and consistent welcome.
• Respond to enquiries and member requests promptly, and make sure no enquiry or issue is left without follow-up.
• Manage routine complaints and service recovery within the studio's policies; bring serious, sensitive, or unresolved issues to the founder.
• Follow up with new members, prospective members, and members at risk of leaving.
• Gather member feedback and report recurring concerns or opportunities for improvement.
• Help build a welcoming community through events, workshops, and thoughtful member communication.Coordinate instructors and the class schedule
• Maintain the instructor schedule and arrange cover when needed.
• Communicate schedule changes clearly to instructors and members.
• Coordinate instructor onboarding and make sure they understand studio procedures and service expectations.
• Monitor class attendance, cancellations, feedback, and operational issues.
• Address routine team coordination issues directly and raise performance, conduct, or contractual matters with the founder.
• Support consistent class standards without taking on teaching responsibilities.Manage memberships and commercial follow-up
• Explain the studio's classes, memberships, and wellness offering clearly to prospective members.
• Follow up on leads, trial visits, renewals, and membership cancellations.
• Monitor enquiries, conversion, attendance, retention, and cancellations.
• Identify patterns affecting membership growth or retention and recommend practical changes.
• Apply approved pricing, discounts, and membership policies consistently; seek approval for exceptions.Maintain control and report performance
• Keep accurate records of sales, payments, attendance, incidents, member feedback, and operational issues.
• Monitor stock levels and routine expenses against the approved budget.
• Prepare a regular management update for the founder covering studio performance, staffing, member experience, maintenance, and outstanding issues.
• Escalate safety concerns, major complaints, unusual financial issues, and expenses or decisions outside agreed limits promptly.Decision-making
The Studio Manager is expected to make day-to-day operational decisions independently within agreed procedures and budget limits. The founder retains approval for changes to pricing or membership terms, significant spending, hiring or termination decisions, policy exceptions, and other major business decisions.
 What we're looking for
• Experience managing a studio, hospitality, wellness, or other service-based operation.
• Strong organization, follow-through, and confidence handling several priorities at once.
• A warm, polished communication style and genuine interest in building member relationships.
• Good judgment and the ability to handle problems calmly and discreetly.
• Confidence using booking, payment, and everyday office software.
• Fluency in French and English; Dutch is an asset.
• A genuine interest in movement and wellness. Pilates experience is welcome but not required.

Do you also love the idea of working in chocolate? Then this opportunity is definitely for you! We are looking for production workers who can help out during the upcoming chocolate season. What will you be doing?
 

 
• Packing pralines, seashell chocolates, chocolate bars, etc. into boxes
 
• Labeling finished products and pallets
 
• Tying ribbons around praline boxes
 
• Applying stickers to finished products
 
• Wrapping boxes in foil
 
• Carrying out quality control checks 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m.–1 p.m. / 1 p.m.–9 p.m.) or possibly a fixed night shift (9 p.m.–5 a.m.)

• You have your own mode of transport

What will you do?

• Thoroughly clean and maintain the production and packaging areas
• Ensure that the communal areas are kept clean and tidy

Are you passionate about chemistry and eager to take your laboratory skills to the next level? Would you enjoy working with advanced testing equipment, exploring innovative materials and learning new techniques in a professional R&D environment?

You will enjoy a varied laboratory position, receive specialised training and benefit from an attractive salary package with excellent additional benefits!

 
• 
 
Perform functional laboratory tests on newly developed chemical formulations and materials.

 
 
• 
 
Carry out photolithographic processes in a cleanroom environment, including coating, exposure and development of silicon wafers.

 
 
• 
 
Inspect coatings and patterns using techniques such as microscopy and thickness measurements.

 
 
•

•

• 
 
Prepare and filter chemical formulations when required.

 
 
• 
 
Analyse, document and report test results, including statistical data.

 
 
• 
 
Perform basic maintenance on laboratory equipment and follow established safety procedures.

 

 
• Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Laboratory Technology or equivalent through relevant experience.
 
• Excellent command of Dutch and English.
 
• 
 
A strong interest in laboratory research, materials testing and chemical applications.

 
 
• 
 
Accurate, analytical and attentive to detail.

 
 
• 
 
Reliable, disciplined and comfortable working according to established procedures.

 
 
• 
 
Able to work both independently and as part of a technical team.

 
 
• 
 
Eager to learn new laboratory techniques and develop your technical expertise.
